cohort: 704 Syrian refugee pregnants and 744 Turkish pregnant women who gave birth at a tertiary center in İstanbul between January 2016 and May 2017
finding: Syrian refugees use antenatal vitamin supplementations at similar rates to Turkish citizens and obstetric and perinatal outcomes are similar between the groups.
mod_finding: Cesarean rates were significantly higher for Turkish patients than in Syrian refugees (42.7% vs 32.7%; p<0.05).
gest_age: 37.7±2.3 weeks for Turkish women, 36.4±2.3 weeks for Syrian refugees
birth_weight: 3134 g for Turkish women, 3066 g for Syrian refugees
